resources.string: Seven everyday tools in one app: tasks, weather, currency, calculator, scanner, steps and flight instruments.
No ads. No trackers. No account. Your data stays on your phone.

Weather: Open-Meteo.com
Places: GeoNames.org, CC BY 4.0
Exchange rates: Exchange Rate API
Coastlines: Natural Earth, public domain
Map imagery: Esri and its providers
